messages.subject: guard refused: /sc:help is never-as-worker
messages.body: guard refused: /sc:help is on the never-as-worker list in ~/.claude/WORKER-CONTRACT.md (section 1, case 3), so it is never dispatched as a worker and has no --unattended mode. I read the contract and the help command file only, ran no listing, wrote no contract and changed no files. To get the listing, run /sc:help in an ordinary top-level session, or send a new Task with a different command.
